title: Proof package entry
description: entry.json of a proof package; the index copy adds `location`.

run.description: command that runs the checker, from the package root

paper.description: journal reference with DOI, and/or arXiv id

produce.description: command that generates the produced inputs, from the package root

location.description: index copy only: GitHub URL at a commit (optionally to a folder), or DOI URL
